Full legal services for international clients

At My Nomad Lawyer, we offer a complete and personalized service for digital nomads, investors, and international professionals. We cover every legal need a foreign client may have in Spain, providing fast, secure, and reliable solutions thanks to our experience and strong network of strategic partners.

Residency & Visas

Residence permits for digital nomads, highly qualified professionals, and families

Investments &
Real Estate

Purchase and sale of properties with full legal guidance

Nationality &
Residency Ties

Processing of nationality applications and residence permits for international clients

Inheritance & Wills

Legal planning, inheritance, and cross-border succession matters

All-In-One Services

Covering all legal needs of foreign clients in Spain
